name: Honeybee
intro: A honeybee is a small insect that makes honey. It lives with many other bees in a hive.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A honeybee is a small insect.
A worker bee is about as long as a grown-up's fingernail.
Its body is covered with tiny hairs.
Worker bees have pollen baskets on their back legs.
The queen bee is bigger than the workers.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Honeybees live in a home called a hive.
Many bees live together in a colony.
One hive can hold thousands of bees.
Bees build honeycomb out of wax.
Each little room in the comb has six sides.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Honeybees visit flowers for food.
They drink sweet nectar from flowers.
They also collect pollen.
Bees turn nectar into honey.
In winter, bees eat the honey they saved.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: Each hive has one queen bee.
The queen lays the eggs.
A baby bee is called a larva.
The larva eats pollen and honey.
Then it changes into a grown-up bee.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Bees dance to show other bees where food is.
Bees help plants make fruits and vegetables.
Honeybees sting only to protect their hive.
Honey color depends on the flowers bees visit.
One worker makes only a tiny bit of honey in her life.

vocab.meaning: The home where a group of bees lives.
A big group of animals that live together.
A yellow powder that flowers make.
A baby insect that looks like a little worm.
